Web Development

Build a website

Pick a layout, edit the content, preview it exactly as exported, then download.

1. Choose a layout

2. Customize content

How to get one (free)

Formspree: create a free account, make a form, copy its address (it looks like https://formspree.io/f/abcdwxyz). Web3Forms: enter your email on web3forms.com, copy the access key, and use https://api.web3forms.com/submit as the address with the key below. Messages then arrive in your email without the visitor needing an email app.

Design Engine: theme & brand

Pick a look, add the client's brand, then fine-tune. Fonts and hero style now come from the theme and brand kit.

Brand kit (saved per client)
A kit is named after the client name above. Save it once, then load it for that client's next project.


Use a Google Font instead

Visitors need internet to see it. Type the exact name from fonts.google.com.

3. Website structure & pages

Create a single-page site, a multipage site with as many pages as you need, or a hybrid. Each page keeps its own content and layout.

History ready
Restore points save a version you can return to
Languages offer your website in more than one language

Each language is its own copy of your website that you translate. Visitors switch with buttons in the header. Extra languages are published in their own folder, for example /sn/ and /nd/. Your photos, colours and custom code stay the same in every language.

The assistant can translate your page text and blocks. Menu names, the footer and the labels below are changed by hand or by editing the fields.

Website labels small words the site adds by itself. Translate these for each language.

Navigation & footer

The menu at the top and the footer at the bottom. They apply to every page of the site.

Navigation menu
Same logo as the brand kit above. Add a dark-background version there.

Links can be #home, #about, #services, #contact, https://…, mailto:…, tel:… or page:… (another page of a multipage site). Pick from the suggestions. An item with a dropdown does not link itself.

Footer

The footer is switched off under Sections above, so none of this will show until you tick Footer again.

Link column 1
Link column 2
Link column 3
{year} becomes the current year. Empty keeps the default line.

Search & sharing (SEO)

What Google shows for this page, and what people see when the link is shared. Title and description are per page; share image, icon and language apply to the whole site.

yourwebsite.com
Photos are cropped to a square.

This page asks search engines not to list it. Use this for drafts, and switch back before launch.

Animations

Gentle movement makes a site feel finished. Visitors who turned on “reduce motion” in their device settings never see it, and the page is fully visible without JavaScript.

Image library

Upload photos once and reuse them in any website. They live in your browser’s image database, not inside your projects, so projects stay small and fast.

4. Image & code tools

Upload a hero image or pick one from your image library; it is embedded into the exported site. Add a code note or inspect common quality checks.

Large images are resized before embedding to keep exports manageable.

ST💫RTECH assistant

Tell it what to change. It suggests edits to your text, theme and blocks. You review and untick anything you do not want, then apply. It never writes code.

What is sent to the AI

Your site name, headline and other page text, the text in your blocks, the theme name and your request. Not sent: email, phone, website address, photos, custom code, your saved projects or your API key. The AI company receives this text. Free plans may use it to improve their models, so do not include private client details.

Blocks: add ready-made sections

Tap a block, fill in simple fields, no code. Blocks appear above Contact. Then tap anything in the preview to fine-tune it.

Custom code (advanced)

For extra styling, analytics, chat widgets and embeds. Pasted code can slow down or break your website, so only use code from sources you trust. It is saved with your project and added to every page when you download.

Scripts do not run inside the studio preview. Download the website and open it to test them. The checklist lists every outside website your code loads from. For code that belongs to one part of the page, add a Custom code block from the blocks above.

5. Extra sections

Add your own sections and reorder them. These custom sections are saved with the currently edited page.

Template Studio

Use your own templates

Import a template, fill it with your content, rearrange or mix sections, and export.

1. My templates

Import .html or .zip files. Scripts are removed for safety. Only use templates you have the right to modify.

Looking for ready-made website templates? They are in the Template Library.

2. Fill placeholders

Tokens like {{headline}} in a template are filled from your content. Values sync with Web Development.

3. Sections and text

Reorder, hide, remove or edit the text of any section.

Mix in a section

Add a section from any imported template. Styles can clash, so check the preview.

4. AI helper (optional)

Rewrites the visible text for your business. Needs internet and an API key (Settings). Free tiers may use prompts to improve models, so avoid private client data.

Backup & restore

One file with your projects, brand kits, themes and favourites, navigation and footer, image library, templates and settings. Your AI key is never included. Browser storage can be cleared, so download a backup regularly. Moving from an older version (V14 or V15)? Browsers keep each file’s data separate, so download a backup there and restore it here with Merge.

AI connection (optional)
